fields.System.Title: Map columns
fields.System.Description: As an admin, I want the importer to suggest a customer field for each column, so that mapping a file is quick.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Given a header that matches a field name, when the file is read, then that field is suggested for the column.
  2. Given a column the admin does not map, when the file is imported, then its values are ignored.
